name: io.github.Servosity/bitdefender-mcp
title: Bitdefender MCP
description: 140 GravityZone API methods, plus fleet health, billing and incident views across child companies.

environmentVariables.name: BITDEFENDER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: GravityZone Control Center API key (My Account > Control Center API).

environmentVariables.name: BITDEFENDER_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional: override the User-Agent the CLI sends.

environmentVariables.name: BITDEFENDER_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: set to 1 so the MCP server runs GravityZone read methods only.

environmentVariables.name: BITDEFENDER_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token callers must present when the server runs with --transport http; not used by stdio.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Not enforced by this connector (no tenant-gated profiles); leave unset. It does not limit access.
